Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal pricing recalibration + addendum orchestration

Claire — great catching up last week. Per our discussion attached is a draft of the updated order form (Uptick_Renewal_OrderForm_v3.pdf) showing: 1) 18-month term (vs. 12), 2) a stepped seat uplift from 2k -> 3.5k tokens/month equivalent, and 3) a one-time usage credit to offset the first invoice during the transition.

Two asks to keep this moving:
- Can procurement/legal at Uptick review and provide a single PDF with their redlines by EOD Thursday (we'd like a single source of truth).
- Confirm the effective date you want on the new order (start of billing vs. signature date).

Internally copying Marcus and Jordan to align on the MSA implications — there are a couple of minor MSA tweaks we expect to surface (retention/incident notification cadence and a short term-specific SLA addendum).

I attached an initial MSA redline we plan to propose (MSA_redlines_naomi_20261119.docx). If you prefer, we can table the MSA redlines and ship an order-form-only addendum first to get the uplift live.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if useful.

— Naomi Feldman

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:01:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: quick read on Uptick redlines

Naomi / Jordan — read Uptick's purchase redline this morning. Quick notes (high level):
- MSA section 4.2 (data retention): they push for 7 years; we should hold to 24 months for inferencing logs and offer a 7-year retention only for audit logs at additional cost.
- SLA/addendum: they added a 99.9% monthly availability ask with credits at small percentages; propose we accept a 99.95% default and put the 99.9% as an optional downtier (cheaper) — avoids unnecessary credit exposure.
- Term: they propose auto-renew with 12-month notice; we typically do auto-renew plus a 60-day notice window. Given the 18-month ask, recommend keeping 60-day notice.
- Pricing: procurement pushed back on how we applied prorated credits. Recommend we make the one-time credit clear as applied to the first invoice and show an example in the order form.

If you want me to draft a short counter-redline set, I can. Also flagging we should loop legal (Laura) for data/retention language — any change there will require an approval by security/compliance.

— Marcus Lin
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: quick read on Uptick redlines

Thanks Marcus — agree with your positions. Laura, looping you to take a look at their retention ask and the SLA language. Specific asks from me:
- Can legal accept the 24-month default retention with a priced extension to 7 years (we'll add a line item on the order form)?
- Relatedly, what is the minimal incident notification cadence we can commit to for an enterprise customer in US region without triggering additional compliance work?

If legal is comfortable, I propose we send a single tracked-change PDF back to Uptick with two redline buckets: (A) non-negotiable commercial items we already decided (order-form numbers, credit mechanics), (B) MSA language with our proposed alternative text and optional priced upgrades.

— Jordan Blake
Renewals Operations, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.ai

On Tue, Nov 17, 2026 at 09:01 Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Naomi / Jordan — read Uptick's purchase redline this morning. Quick notes...

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 14:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: quick read on Uptick redlines (legal input)

Naomi / Jordan / Marcus — thanks for the notes. Legal review summary below (high level):
- Retention: Security & legal prefer 24 months for inference logs; we can offer an add-on for 7 years if Uptick certifies purpose + pays for the storage/retention fee. Draft clause attached (MSA_redlines_naomi_20261119.docx).
- SLA: 99.95% baseline with clearly defined measurement window and a capped credit schedule is fine. I attached a brief table of proposed credit bands.
- Auto-renew: keep 60-day cancellation window; we will not change to annual auto-renew without added repricing protections for Redwood.
- Change control: request explicit language that any future addenda with pricing changes require mutual written consent — prevents unilateral procurement-side edits.

Next steps I recommend: we prepare a single tracked-change packet (MSA + order form) and send to Claire with a clear cover note that differentiates commercial vs. legal redlines. I can convert to PDF and include a one-page summary for their procurement.

If you approve, I'll:
1) produce the tracked-change PDF and a one-page summary,
2) push final assets into the HubSpot deal (HUB-37845) and add a DocuSign envelope for the order,
3) notify Security to pre-approve retention extension process so we can accept a 7-year add-on if they sign it.

Please confirm and I'll schedule the send.

— Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.ai

Attachments: MSA_redlines_naomi_20261119.docx (docx); SLA_credit_table.pdf (pdf)

Claire / Oliver — thanks for the fast turnaround. We've consolidated our positions and Laura has prepared a tracked-change packet (attached) plus a one-page summary that separates commercial items from legal language. High level:
- Order: 18-month term, seat uplift to 3.5k equivalent, one-time credit applied to first invoice (example math included).
- MSA: default 24-month retention; 7-year retention available as priced add-on (requires a compliance attestation).
- SLA: 99.95% baseline; credit bands included in packet.

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached tracked packet (PDF) and the one-pager and confirm any remaining redlines by EOD Monday so we can route to DocuSign the same week.
2) If procurement prefers, we can send the order as a stand-alone DocuSign envelope and table the MSA language until the order is signed. That will get the uplift live faster.
3) HubSpot: I'll add the assets to HUB-37845 and include the DocuSign link.

Appreciate the partnership — we want to make this as low-friction as possible.
